title: TimeSage-EV: A Live Benchmark for Agentic Time Series Analysis in Evolving Environments
abstract: arXiv:2608.14270v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time series analysis in high-stakes domains relies on recurring data releases, where new observations can alter the evidence base and the validity of later conclusions. Existing time series QA benchmarks mostly rely on fixed snapshots, leaving temporal validity and cutoff-aware evidence use unevaluated. We introduce TimeSage-EV, a live benchmark for agentic time series analysis in evolving environments. It tracks 60 real institutional scenarios across 6 domains, comprising 1,485 scenario-period QA pairs from Feb 2023 to May 2026 and spanning monthly, weekly, daily, and irregular release cadences. At each period, large language model (LLM) agents receive time series data and source reports, while the withheld target release provides ground truth. translated_title: TimeSage-EV：面向演化环境的智能体时间序列分析的实时基准
translated_abstract: 在高风险领域中的时间序列分析依赖于定期发布的数据，新观测值可能会改变证据基础及后续结论的有效性。现有时间序列问答基准大多依赖固定快照，未评估时间有效性和基于截止日期的证据使用。我们引入了TimeSage-EV，一个面向演化环境中智能体时间序列分析的实时基准。它追踪了6个领域中的60个真实机构场景，包含从2023年2月至2026年5月的1,485个场景-周期问答对，覆盖月度、周度、日度及不规则发布节奏。在每个周期，大型语言模型（LLM）智能体会收到时间序列数据和源报告，而被扣留的目标发布则提供真实标签。TimeSage-EV评估状态识别、数据总结和前景推理。实验涉及前沿LLM智能体及TimeSage-1.0，一种具有可复用分析能力的自演化智能体。
tldr: 本文提出了一个实时基准TimeSage-EV，用于评估LLM智能体在动态数据环境中的时间序列分析能力，并引入自演化智能体TimeSage-1.0以提升跨周期的分析适应性和可复用性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TimeSage-EV, a live benchmark for evaluating LLM agents' time series analysis in evolving data environments, along with TimeSage-1.0, a self-evolving agent that enhances cross-period adaptability and reusability.
